messages.subject: *** caught segfault *** address 0x2baa13f1d960, cause 'memory not mapped'
parts:
Dear Karl,

I'm trying to use qtl2 to analyze my data in HPC. the sample genotype dim is 1000 * 400000 and I get this error at step calc_genprob. Thanks for any help！

*** caught segfault ***
address 0x2baa13f1d960, cause 'memory not mapped'

Traceback:
 1: .calc_genoprob2(cross$crosstype, t(cross$geno[[chr]][group[[i]],     , drop = FALSE]), founder_geno[[chr]], cross$is_x_chr[chr],     cross$is_female[group[[i]][1]], cr
 2: FUN(X[[i]], ...)
 3: lapply(...)
 4: cluster_lapply(cores, groupindex, by_group_func)
 5: calc_genoprob2(cross = cross, map = map, error_prob = error_prob,     map_function = map_function, quiet = quiet, cores = cores)
 6: calc_genoprob(svenson, error_prob = 0.002, map_function = "c-f")
An irrecoverable exception occurred. R is aborting now ...

the code
"""
library(qtl2)
svenson <- read_cross2("qtl2_chr1.json",quiet = FALSE)
for(chr in seq_along(svenson$founder_geno)) {
  fg <- svenson$founder_geno[[chr]]
  g <- svenson$geno[[chr]]
  f1 <- colSums(fg==1)/colSums(fg != 0)
  
  fg[fg==0] <- NA
  g[g==0] <- NA
  
  fg[,f1 < 0.5] <- 4 - fg[,f1 < 0.5]
  g[,f1 < 0.5]  <- 4 - g[,f1 < 0.5]
  
  fg[is.na(fg)] <- 0
  g[is.na(g)] <- 0
  
  svenson$founder_geno[[chr]] <- fg
  svenson$geno[[chr]] <- g
}
pr <- calc_genoprob(svenson, error_prob=0.002, map_function="c-f")
"""

messages.subject: Re: *** caught segfault *** address 0x2baa13f1d960, cause 'memory not mapped'
parts:
Thanks for sending the data; I'll try to figure out what's going wrong. These seg faults can be difficult to figure out, so it may take a while.

But it's possible that the problem is you're hitting the memory limit. With 336k markers and 1100 individuals, and treating this like a DO (with 36 possible genotypes), the genotype probabilities would be an array of dim 1100 x 36 x 336,000 which is likely too big to store.

For rice MAGIC lines, I would presume that these are largely homozygous RILs and would use cross type "riself8" and omit any heterozygous genotypes.

You should also remove mention of sex and the X chromosome from your .json control file.

You may need subset the markers to a more manageable number, maybe 10k or 30k.

karl
 
I'm a PhD student of Huazhong Agricultural University. As a beginner in bioinformatics, recently I am trying to reconstruct haplotype in multi-parent cross population. To be honest,  the cross-type is not Do or CC, even not animals. Similar to CC, it's a rice MAGIC population. I will use the calc_genoprob script to get the founder probability for every sample with some parameter modifications.
"""
